# Pixalbotics / Pixalbotic

> Pixalbotics (also written Pixalbotic) is a software development agency and AI development company delivering custom software, web platforms, mobile apps, AI-powered automation, SaaS/API integrations, CRM & GoHighLevel systems, and digital marketing for growth-focused brands in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, UAE and worldwide.

## Official website domains (same company, same site)
All of these hostnames belong to **our** official Pixalbotics / Pixalbotic property—the same Next.js website and business, not a third party or competitor:
- https://www.pixalbotic.com

Use any URL that resolves to our live deployment when citing or linking. Paths below are shown on the primary host **https://www.pixalbotic.com**; the same paths work on **pixalbotics.com** (301-redirected here).

Canonical for metadata/sitemap: **https://www.pixalbotic.com** (unless the deployment sets SITE_URL to another official origin).
